gate.rule: Enable output at origin t only if forecasts whose whole target block ended by t beat zero by the threshold.

protocol.selection_rule: Detector: fewest development false+missed tone-updates, tie: shorter warm-up, larger alpha. Gate: best worst-case then mean development band gain.

adaptation_budgets.fixed_top3_tracker: estimate_tones on 6 s prefix (unchanged earlier method), frozen afterwards
adaptation_budgets.adapted_ridge_ar / adapted_mlp: fit on 6 s prefix of each new scene
adaptation_budgets.frozen_pooled_mlp: weights from three development sources only; prefix scaling only
adaptation_budgets.auto_selected_tracker: online, uses only the latest 1 s window for detection and 0.6 s for fitting; no prefix fit

protocol.limitations: Synthetic reference only, one seed per scene, no acoustic path, playback timing or microphone processing. Not evidence of physical ANC.
